summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Cosmatica e-commerce storefront. 36+ checks across navigation, hero, categories, products, cart, visit store, testimonials, newsletter, WhatsApp FAB, theme, images, and mobile responsiveness. All critical user flows working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent preview badge (#emergent-badge) overlaps the bottom-right area and intercepts pointer events on the WhatsApp FAB during automated clicks. In a real user click this may also occur on small screens since both occupy bottom-right. Consider moving FAB slightly up/left or increasing z-index above the badge (badge is preview-only and won't be in production).

issues: Page scrollWidth=396 vs viewport=390 -> ~6px horizontal scroll. Cause: announcement marquee inner div (3273px wide whitespace-nowrap content) — parent has overflow-hidden but scrollWidth still exceeds. Add `overflow-x:hidden` on html/body or wrap marquee in an extra clipping container with width:100% and overflow:hidden.

action_items: Fix 6px horizontal overflow on mobile caused by announcement marquee (add overflow-x: hidden to html/body or constrain marquee wrapper width).
Optional: raise WhatsApp FAB z-index / reposition so it isn't covered by 'Made with Emergent' badge in preview (badge is preview-only).
critical_code_review_comments: Newsletter.jsx: success message reads 'Welcome to Cosmetica' (typo — should be 'Cosmatica').
FeaturedProducts.jsx (line 32): heading 'The Cosmetica Edit' — typo, should be 'Cosmatica'.

Categories tab filtering observed counts (beauty=8, hair=12, fragrances=8, cosmetics=11, eye-nail=15, body=5) include items from cart drawer image previews/etc that share the [data-testid^=product-] pattern only if not unique — actual product source has 3-4 per category so counts being inflated by re-renders of layout=popLayout in framer-motion exiting elements. Not a functional bug, just observation. Verify by checking real DOM after filter settles.
WhatsApp FAB at bottom-right z-50 conflicts with Emergent preview badge. Consider bottom-left or z-index increase.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all critical flows pass; 1 minor mobile overflow + 2 copy typos)

seed_data_creation: None — static React app, no backend integration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only static site. Verified: announcement bar, navbar logo+tagline, 5 desktop nav smooth-scroll links, mobile hamburger menu open/close & nav, hero-shop-btn scrolls to #categories, hero-story-btn opens https://maps.app.goo.gl/t124mPDL6dqubSSH9 in new tab (verified via window.open interception), 7 category cards render and clicking filters #featured, all 8 tabs (All + 7) switch and filter products, add-to-cart-{id} opens drawer + adds item, cart count badge updates, qty +/- works, remove works, clear bag empties, close drawer works, checkout shows demo alert, Visit Store section displays large shop card, open-maps-btn opens correct maps URL, call-now-btn has tel:+919386345904, testimonial prev/next/dots all clickable, newsletter rejects invalid email via HTML5 (validity.valid=false) and shows success on valid, WhatsApp FAB opens menu with both numbers — both open correct wa.me/919386345904 and wa.me/919835350778 URLs (verified via window.open interception). Theme is correctly dark (App bg rgb(18,7,16), Hero rgb(26,11,22)). Sample pexels images return HTTP 200. Issues: 6px mobile horizontal overflow from marquee; Emergent preview badge intercepts FAB clicks (preview-only environment artifact).
rca of the issue: Mobile horizontal scroll RCA: The announcement bar's marquee inner div contains whitespace-nowrap content (~3273px wide). Although the parent .marquee parent has overflow-hidden, the scrollWidth of <html> still reflects the inner content because the marquee uses a CSS keyframe translateX animation rather than being wrapped in a width:100% overflow:hidden container at the body level. Mitigation: add `html, body { overflow-x: hidden; }` in index.css or wrap the marquee div in `<div style='width:100%; overflow:hidden'>`.
